europe_now.title: Poland Airspace Breach
europe_now.summary: Polish authorities scrambled fighter jets after a Russian helicopter breached national airspace near the border.

europe_now.title: Poland and Belarus Diplomatic Talks
europe_now.summary: The foreign ministers of Poland and Belarus met to discuss a potential thaw in bilateral relations for the first time in ten years.

top_stories.title: Ukraine Conflict at the United Nations
top_stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky addressed the UN General Assembly regarding ongoing hostilities and foreign fighters. He emphasized that Russian forces continue intensive bombing campaigns against targets in Kyiv.
